description: Route for direction/taste disagreements that findings-union loops cannot converge: classify the disagreement, decide evidence-decidable disputes by evidence, escalate taste/direction disputes to a human by default. The artifact is a decision record, not a findings JSON.

steps.label: classify-disagreement
steps.description: Host classifies the disagreement: 'evidence-decidable' (an independent source can settle it — path:line, command output, or official documentation) versus 'taste/direction' (no independent evidence can settle it; the dispute is about values, style, or product direction).
steps.expected_artifact: classification record stating the dispute, the classification, and why
steps.stop_condition: every open disagreement has a recorded classification

steps.label: evidence-adjudication
steps.description: For evidence-decidable disputes: dispatch heterogeneous verification (read the cited file, run the deterministic command, check the official doc) and rule strictly by the evidence. No voting — evidence decides, even when it sides with the minority.
steps.expected_artifact: per-dispute evidence record (path:line / command output / source citation) plus the ruling it forces
steps.stop_condition: each evidence-decidable dispute is settled by first-hand evidence
steps.escalation: evidence turns out unobtainable or ambiguous -> reclassify the dispute as taste/direction and proceed to step 3

steps.label: human-escalation
steps.description: For taste/direction disputes: escalate to the human by default. Heterogeneous runner opinions are attached as advisory evidence only — they do not decide. A 2/3 majority may be followed ONLY when the human has explicitly pre-authorized 'go with the majority' for this dispute. A needs_human signal from any single auditor escalates immediately and cannot be overruled by a majority vote.
steps.expected_artifact: escalation brief: each party's position, its supporting argument, the advisory opinions, and the question posed to the human
steps.stop_condition: the human has ruled, or has explicitly authorized majority rule and the majority outcome is recorded
steps.escalation: needs_human from any auditor -> human, unconditionally; one vote suffices, majority cannot veto it

steps.label: decision-record
steps.description: Write the decision record: each party's position, the evidence considered, the final ruling, and the rationale. File it in the repository's decision-log location. This artifact is prose for humans — deliberately not a findings JSON, because direction outcomes must be readable as decisions, not re-enter the blocker pipeline.
steps.expected_artifact: decision record (positions + evidence + ruling + rationale) in the decision log
steps.stop_condition: the decision record is on disk and referenced from the run state

stop_conditions: every disagreement is classified, and the classification is recorded
evidence-decidable disputes are settled by first-hand evidence, not by vote
taste/direction disputes are ruled by the human (or by a majority the human explicitly authorized in advance)
any needs_human signal resulted in escalation — it was never outvoted
a decision record exists for every settled dispute
anti_patterns: ap1:union-loop-on-direction — feeding a direction dispute into the findings-union convergence loop (it never converges)
ap2:same-family-three-votes — collecting three votes from the same model family and calling it a majority
ap3:majority-overrules-needs-human — using a 2/3 vote to suppress an auditor's needs_human signal
ap4:vote-on-taste-without-authorization — settling a taste dispute by vote when the human never authorized majority rule
